6768.title: ACP progress bypasses output normalization
6768.rootCauseOneLine: ACP text content is forwarded as output, while only command output has a dialect normalization boundary; generic progress and close extraction bypass it.

prReviews.topFinding: Adds the missing normalization boundary; provider phase filtering and lifecycle interoperability were not live-verified.

6768.proposedFix: Provide dialect-controlled non-command progress and terminal normalization, preserve command behavior and actual JSON output, and implement provider-specific phase tracking. Do not duplicate open PR 6769.
6768.caveats: Verified twice with synthetic events against the real translator, not live Kimi or browser rendering. The same agent ran both clean checkouts. No fix PR opened because an existing open PR links to this issue.
